A replica can't set the DC level of a high-gain node, which is why the last few iterations railed. This edit switches to a telescopic OTA. A resistor divider generates an exact 0.75 V reference for the second input and the NMOS cascode gate voltage. A PMOS cascode mirror biased through a series resistor sets the output DC at VDD − Vsg. A resistor Rg from vout to that mirror node fixes the gain inside the 51–54 dB window that the f3db spec needs.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Replica approach rails (vout 0.09 V). Switch to telescopic OTA: divider-made 0.75 V reference on the second input, self-biased PMOS cascode mirror sets vout_dc = VDD - Vsg (~1.05 V), Rg from vout to the mirror node (zero DC current) caps gain near 53.5 dB so f3db >= 66 kHz."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "It":     (20e-6, 14e-6, 24e-6),
    "gmid1":  (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),
    "L1":     (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid3":  (15.0, 9.0, 20.0),
    "L3":     (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid_p": (7.0, 5.0, 11.0),
    "Lp":     (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),
    "gmid6":  (10.0, 6.0, 16.0),
    "Adb":    (53.5, 52.0, 55.0),
    "vds1t":  (0.22, 0.15, 0.35),
    "vsd4t":  (0.25, 0.18, 0.4),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vcm = spec.get("vin_dc", spec.get("vcm", 0.75))
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It = p["It"]
    I = It / 2.0
    Idiv = 1.5e-6
    gmid_t, Lt = 12.0, 1.0

    # gain pair (bulk at vss -> body effect), iterate on tail node voltage
    vs = 0.25
    for _ in range(4):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I, vds=p["vds1t"], vsb=vs)
        vs = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.12)
    xa = vs + p["vds1t"]

    # tail mirror from ibias diode
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmid_t, Lt, iref, vds=0.6)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmid_t, Lt, iref, vds=mb0.vgs)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmid_t, Lt, It, vds=vs)

    # PMOS self-biased cascode mirror
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=p["vsd4t"])
    vC = vdd - m4.vgs                     # = output DC at balance
    s6 = vdd - p["vsd4t"]
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid6"], p["Lp"], I, vds=max(s6 - vC, 0.1))
    IR = max(p["vsd4t"] - m4.vgs + m6.vgs, 0.03)
    Rs = IR / I
    vB = vC - IR

    # NMOS cascodes
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I, vds=max(vC - xa, 0.15), vsb=xa)
    vbn = xa + m3.vgs
    vbn = min(max(vbn, vcm + 0.05), vdd - 0.1)

    # divider: vdd - Ra - vbn - Rb - vref - Rc - vss
    Ra = (vdd - vbn) / Idiv
    Rb = (vbn - vcm) / Idiv
    Rc = vcm / Idiv

    # gain setting
    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout_n = m1.gds * m3.gds / (m3.gm + m3.gmbs + m3.gds)
    gout_p = m4.gds * m6.gds / (m6.gm + m6.gds)
    Atgt = 10 ** (p["Adb"] / 20.0)
    gneed = gm1 / Atgt - gout_n - gout_p
    Rg = 1.0 / max(gneed, 1e-9)
    Rg = min(max(Rg, 2e4), 1e9)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("Mb0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("Mt", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.R("Ra", "vdd", "vbn", Ra)
    n.R("Rb", "vbn", "vref", Rb)
    n.R("Rc", "vref", "vss", Rc)
    n.dev("M1", "a", "vin", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "b", "vref", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3a", "nb", "vbn", "a", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M3b", "vout", "vbn", "b", "vss", m3)
    n.R("Rs", "nc", "nb", Rs)
    n.dev("M4", "s6", "nc", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M5", "s7", "nc", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M6", "nc", "nb", "s6", "s6", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "nb", "s7", "s7", m6)
    n.R("Rg", "vout", "nc", Rg)

    gout = gout_n + gout_p + 1.0 / Rg
    rout = 1.0 / gout
    A = gm1 * rout
    ctot = cl + m3.cdd + m6.cdd + m3.cgd + m6.cgd
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * ctot)
    f3db = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rout * ctot)
    vlow = xa + m3.vdsat + 0.05
    vhigh = s6 - m6.vdsat - 0.05
    power = vdd * (iref + It + Idiv)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "gbw": gbw, "f3db": f3db, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vC, "swing": vhigh - vlow}
```
